Instead of having to manage permissions for every individual app or website, a user can use a Consent Manager to authorize or revoke access to their data across different platforms, ensuring higher privacy standards.

story.title: MeitY DPDP Act Implementation
story.so_far: The DPDP Act, passed in 2023, is India's framework for data privacy, designed to give citizens more control over how their personal information is collected and used online. It requires companies to act with transparency and provides for third-party intermediaries to manage user consent settings.

timeline.text: A formal registration framework and online portal for entities acting as Consent Managers have been launched.
